data.gender_notes: Jacki is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Iakchē was a goddess who presided over childbirth and childcare. The name Jacki is derived from this Greek goddess, and carries the symbolism of new life, nurturing, and motherly love. The name Jacki carries the meaning “Goddess of the childbirth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jacki usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the childbirth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jacki total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: ג'אקי
in_hebrew.meaning: לא ניתן למצוא משמעות ישירה לעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'אקי אינו מופיע ישירות במקרא או במילון העברי המסורתי. עם זאת, ניתן לומר כי השם קשור לשם יעקב, שפירושו 'הוא יחליף' או 'אל יעקב'.

in_greek.name: Τζάκι
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Τζάκι δεν έχει άμεση σημασία στα ελληνικά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζάκι πιθανότατα προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα יעקב (Ya'akov), που σημαίνει 'αυτός που θα αντικαταστήσει' ή 'Ακωβ'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Τζάκι μπορεί να σχετίζεται με την έννοια της αλλαγής ή της αντικατάστασης.

in_latin.name: Jacki
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Jacki significationem directam non habet
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jacki a nomine ebraico יעקב (Ya'akov) derivatum est, quod significat 'is qui substituet' vel 'Iacobus'. In traditione christiana, nomen Jacki potest referri ad conceptum substitutionis vel mutationis.

in_english.name: Jacki
in_english.meaning: Derived from Jacob, meaning 'he who supplants' or 'God will replace'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jacki is a variant of the name Jack, which is derived from the Hebrew name יעקב (Ya'akov), meaning 'he who supplants' or 'God will replace'. The name has its roots in the biblical figure of Jacob, who was renamed Israel after wrestling with an angel. In Christian tradition, the name Jacki is often associated with the qualities of perseverance, determination, and spiritual growth. The name has been popularized in various cultures, including English-speaking countries, where it is often used as a shortened form of Jackson or Jacqueline.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jacki, derived from the Greek goddess Iakchē, has been used in various Western cultures as a given name for girls. Its connection to the ancient goddess of childbirth and childcare gives it a deep-rooted symbolism of nurturing, motherhood, and the gift of new life.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Jacki can represent the qualities of a loving and caring maternal figure. It serves as a reminder of the divine feminine, the nurturing and protective energy that sustains and supports us throughout life, much like Iakchē did for the newborns in Greek mythology. The name fosters feelings of comfort, compassion, and a deep connection to the natural cycles of life, especially in relation to the miracle of birth and child rearing.
